sections.shortTitle: Sindh Civil Servants Assessment of Suitability of Appointments Repeal Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XX OF 2001
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (ASSESSMENT OF SUITABILITY OF APPOINTMENTS)
(REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XX OF 2001
An Ordinance to repeal the Sindh Civil Servants
(Assessment of Suitability of Appointments) Ordinance, 2001.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
15th June, 2001]
No. S.LEGIS.1(20)/2001, dated 15-6-2001.--The following Ordinance
made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Sindh Civil Servants (Assessment of Suitability of Appointments) (Repeal)
Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
